records.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: On-policy agentic RL distillation method focuses on training, not inference systems.

records.title: TokenMixer-Large: Scaling Up Large Ranking Models in Industrial Recommenders
records.reason: TokenMixer-Large is an industrial recommendation ranking model with sparse-per-token experts, custom operators, FP8 and token-parallel serving. The engineering is inference-relevant but its architecture, workload and quality metrics are recommender-specific, so LLM transfer remains uncertain.

records.title: Efficient Inference for Large Vision-Language Models: Bottlenecks, Techniques, and Prospects
records.reason: This survey systematically organizes LVLM inference bottlenecks and techniques across encoding, prefill, decode and system levels. It is a useful systems taxonomy but is a survey rather than a novel LLM serving method and focuses on multimodal vision-language workloads.

records.title: Towards Scientific Intelligence: A Survey of LLM-based Scientific Agents
records.reason: This survey reviews scientific-agent architectures, benchmarks and applications. Its subject is agent capability/workflows rather than serving, KV management or inference optimization; relevance through agent scheduling is indirect.

records.title: On gate level power optimization using dual-supply voltages
records.reason: Dual-supply gate-level power optimization predates and is unrelated to LLM inference systems.
